//: REFERENCE copy of every setting with its default value.
//clientId: Leave EMPTY to use the shared Discord app baked into this build (zero setup — the normal case). Only set this to override with your OWN Discord Application ID (digits only). `claude-presence setup` can do it for you.
//detection: How and how often Claude is detected.
//activity: Tells 'actually using Claude' apart from 'Claude is just open': Claude Code's session registry says when a session is busy, otherwise how recently Claude wrote to its own session/storage files (mtimes only, never contents). Falls back to 'active' when it can't tell. hideWhenIdle clears the presence entirely while idle; pauseStatsWhenIdle only counts time you're really active. detectClaudeCode counts a live Claude Code session as 'in use' even with no app window.
//behaviour: 'clear' keeps the helper alive and hides presence on close; 'exit' shuts it down.
//model: Which model to show. The app doesn't expose this reliably, so 'label' is the dependable source; 'detect' is best-effort and may be blank.
//usage: The desktop app is a flat subscription (no per-message $), so we show your plan name + real local time instead of a misleading dollar figure. showLimits adds the plan's REAL 5-hour / 7-day usage meters (read from the desktop app's plan-usage-history.json, only while fresh). Set showOnCard:true to also put the plan on the always-visible second line (Model · Plan), not just the hover tooltip.
//project: Details of the Claude Code session that is open, for {project} {branch} {title} {messages} {tokens}. label pins a project name instead of detecting one.
//theme: A built-in look to start from: default | minimal | coder | stats | chill. Anything set explicitly in this file still wins.
//presence: How the status looks. Every text field may use {placeholders}: {model} {plan} {project} {branch} {title} {messages} {tokens} {sessions} {status} {session} {idle} {today} {month} {total} {streak} {usage5h} {usage7d} {time}. Image values must be art-asset KEYS uploaded to the Discord app being used (a raw https URL does not render). Leave an image empty to show none.
